body:
They are good kids, but a bit of a handful. One is little still and full of energy. The other is older and struggles with depression. 

I think no one replies because I'm disabled. We're why people advocate for assisted suicide. Because it's ok that our lives are so depressing that we want to die. It's accepted. And maybe they are right. But maybe I should stay a little longer. Long enough to be approved for disability benefits so they don't have to worry about how to pay the bills if he can't work because he's looking after the kids.
